description:
Tableau de bord de surveillance en temps réel des opérations de forage pétrolier.
Affiche les métriques clés de trois puits (Well-01, Well-02, Well-03) : performance de forage, mécanique, hydraulique, profondeur, gaz et densité de boue.
Données mises à jour toutes les 5 secondes via InfluxDB.

targets.query:
SELECT last("GS_ACTC") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
AND "well_id" = 'Well-01'

SELECT last("GS_ACTC") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
AND "well_id" = 'Well-02'

SELECT last("GS_ACTC") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
AND "well_id" = 'Well-03'

SELECT last("GS_DMEA") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY "well_id"

SELECT last("GS_ROP") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY "well_id"

SELECT last("GS_SWOB") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY "well_id"

SELECT last("GS_RPM") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY "well_id"

SELECT last("GS_SPPA") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY "well_id"

SELECT last("GS_TFLO") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY "well_id"

SELECT mean("GS_ROP") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(2s), "well_id" fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_RPM") AS "RPM"
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(2s), "well_id" fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_SWOB")
FROM "drilling"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time(2s), "well_id" fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_TQA") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(2s), "well_id" fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_HKLD") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(2s), "well_id" fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_SPPA") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(2s), "well_id" fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_TFLO") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(2s), "well_id" fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_MFOA") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(2s), "well_id" fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_SPM1") + mean("GS_SPM2") as "Total SPM"
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(2s), "well_id" fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_TFLO") - mean("GS_MFOA") AS "Balance" 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(2s), "well_id" fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_DMEA") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(2s), "well_id" fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_GASA") 
FROM "drilling" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(2s), "well_id" fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_MWTI") AS "Boue Entrante",
mean("GS_MDOA") AS "Boue Sortante"
FROM "drilling"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time(2s), "well_id" fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_G_C1") AS "C1 Méthane",
mean("GS_G_C2") AS "C2 Éthane",
mean("GS_G_C3") AS "C3 Propane",
mean("GS_GASA") AS "Total Gaz"
FROM "drilling"
WHERE $timeFilter AND "well_id" = 'Well-01'
GROUP BY time(2s) fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_G_C1") AS "C1 Méthane",
mean("GS_G_C2") AS "C2 Éthane",
mean("GS_G_C3") AS "C3 Propane",
mean("GS_GASA") AS "Total Gaz"
FROM "drilling"
WHERE $timeFilter AND "well_id" = 'Well-02'
GROUP BY time(2s) fill(linear)

SELECT mean("GS_G_C1") AS "C1 Méthane",
mean("GS_G_C2") AS "C2 Éthane",
mean("GS_G_C3") AS "C3 Propane",
mean("GS_GASA") AS "Total Gaz"
FROM "drilling"
WHERE $timeFilter AND "well_id" = 'Well-03'
GROUP BY time(2s) fill(linear)

panels.description: Vue complète de tous les paramètres de forage pour Puit 01.

targets.query:
SELECT mean("GS_ROP") AS "Vit. Pénétration",
mean("GS_RPM") AS "Vit. Rotation",
mean("GS_TQA") AS "Couple",
mean("GS_SWOB") AS "Poids Trépan",
mean("GS_HKLD") AS "Charge Crochet",
mean("GS_TFLO") AS "Débit Boue",
mean("GS_SPPA") AS "Pression",
mean("GS_DMEA") AS "Profondeur"
FROM "drilling"
WHERE $timeFilter AND "well_id" = 'Well-01'
GROUP BY time(2s) fill(linear)
